dmu.text: Shanna Sisay, a descendant of Captain Sisay, takes up the Weatherlight when Jhoira gives her the ship, and when Karn calls it with the amulet she promises to come.

A skeletal dragon attacks the Weatherlight, which is left grounded in Otaria with cracked moderator rods, so Shanna, Raff and Tiana seek magic in the mountains, where they find a smoky, magic-eating barrier.

Braids offers help if they kill her shard-self, and Shanna walks alone through the barrier to confront a nightmare version of Sisay that mocks her legacy and shows her visions of her friends dying, and she destroys it.

When they return, the Weatherlight has become a Phyrexian monstrosity, and Shanna and Tiana enter it to destroy tentacles wearing the heads of Botono, Ulaten and Anyxni and to free Slimefoot and the powerstone before they escape.
